privacyDoc.title: Privacy policy
privacyDoc.draft: Draft - before public launch this text will be prepared or reviewed by a lawyer.

s1.title: Data controller
s1.body: The data controller is the owner of Cookivo. Contact details will be added before the public launch.

s2.title: What we collect
s2.body: Your username, email address and a password hash (we never store the password itself). Optionally - with your explicit consent - health data: weight, height, allergies and intolerances, used to calculate your needs and filter recipes.

s3.title: Legal basis and purpose
s3.body: We run your account under a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Health data is processed only with your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.

s4.title: Your rights
s4.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and export your data, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

s5.title: Security
s5.body: Passwords are hashed with Argon2id, connections are encrypted and your session lives in a secure cookie that scripts can't read. We don't sell data or use advertising cookies.

termsDoc.title: Terms of service
termsDoc.draft: Draft - before public launch this text will be prepared or reviewed by a lawyer.

s1.title: General
s1.body: Cookivo is a service for planning meals, creating recipes and shopping lists.

s2.title: Account
s2.body: Full features require an account. You are responsible for keeping your password safe.

s3.title: User content
s3.body: By publishing recipes and photos you confirm you hold the rights to them. Offensive or unlawful content may be removed by moderators.

s4.title: Not medical advice
s4.body: Calorie and macro calculations are estimates and do not replace advice from a doctor or dietitian.

s5.title: Deleting your account
s5.body: You can delete your account together with your data at any time.

howItWorks.lead: Cookivo calculates your needs using proven formulas, then matches recipes to your goal, taste and allergies.

bmr.title: Metabolic rate
bmr.body: The Mifflin-St Jeor equation estimates how much energy you burn at rest.

activity.title: Activity
activity.body: We multiply the result by an activity factor - from 1.2 to 1.9.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body: A cut subtracts 10–20% of calories, a bulk adds 10%. We never go below a safe minimum.

macros.title: Macronutrients
macros.body: Protein depends on weight and goal, fat is 30% of energy, carbohydrates fill the rest.
